appraisal_events.evidence: je savais... qu'il serait reçu dans une pitié plus vaste encore; que tout ce qui était mien, mes soucis, mon vouloir, serait, en ma grand'mère, étayé sur un désir de conservation et d'accroissement de ma propre vie autrement fort que celui que j'avais de moi-même
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator recalls his in-scene self as wholly absorbed into and secured by his grandmother's boundless care, staging him as completely included in and sustained by her devotion, in contrast to the isolation implied for those cared for by mere servants.

status_effects.explanation: The in-scene narrator moves from a state of isolation and fear into one of deep emotional security and inclusion within his grandmother's undeviating love and attention.

ambiguities: The narrator's inclusion in the grandmother's care is largely the flip side of her own already-scored elevation (E1); it is included here only because the passage also stages a distinct emotional shift for the narrator himself (from prior isolation to secured intimacy), not to re-score or contradict the accepted annotation.
